description: This file defines the EntityCondition class, which implements the <entity-condition> element for processing entity conditions within the Minilang framework. It includes logic for initializing the condition, executing find operations, gathering artifact information, and generating a string representation.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Implements the <entity-condition> element for executing entity-based conditions within the MiniLang framework. Handles validation, execution of find operations, artifact info gathering, and string representation.

classes.name: EntityConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of EntityCondition, providing method creation and name retrieval.

methods.name: EntityCondition (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an EntityCondition object by validating the given XML element and creating a ByConditionFinder instance.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity condition operation by invoking the finder to perform a database find, handling exceptions and logging warnings.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information, specifically the entity name, for build-time analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the entity condition, including the entity name.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create an EntityCondition instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'entity-condition'.
